newsitem.title: USA: The Cooper Cos gets lower loan rate.
newsitem.headline: The Cooper Cos gets lower loan rate.

text.p: The Cooper Cos Inc said Wednesday it had completed an agreement with its lender to amend the $11 million of its affiliate, Hospital Group of America Inc, that would lower the interest rate on its loan by two percentage points.
The company said the lower rate would be effective at the beginning of the 1997 fiscal year, resulting in annual savings of about $220,000.
The Cooper Cos currently pays an interest rate of prime plus 4 percent, which currently amounts to 12.25 percent, a spokesman said.
